description: Cluster 1 contains 308 publications (30.80%) that have a main theme focused on CSR and consumer behavior. The main articles address purchase intention (Shin et al., 2021; Wang et al., 2020b), brand influence (Sipilä et al., 2021), and cultural characteristics influencing consumer behavior (Friske et  al., 2022).

Cluster 2 has 262 publications (26.20%), with emphasis on CSR and stakeholders. In this cluster, the authors addressed the relationship between CSR and the influence of social characteristics such as legislation (López-Arceiz et al., 2020), policy (Rodgers et al., 2019), economic context (Schneider, 2020), citizenship (Ivanova-Gongne et  al., 2022), privatization (Khan et al., 2021), internationalization of companies (Sahasranamam et al., 2022), governmental pressure (Giamporcaro et al., 2020), and diversity of employees (Dahms et al., 2022) in major publications.

Cluster 3 has 250 publications (25.00%) that have the main theme of the process of disseminating results related to CSR. The main works in this group deal with the factors that impact CSR disclosures (García-Sánchez et al., 2021; Zhao et al., 2022) as well as the factors that are impacted by such disclosures (Du & Yu, 2021; Lin et al., 2020a).

Cluster 4 has 180 publications (18.00%) that have the main theme of the relationship between CSR and financial and social performance. In this cluster, publications are related to market value (Hannah et al., 2021), financial return (Yenet al., 2019), public policy (Long et al., 2020), and moral management (Janani et al., 2022), among others.
